LLM Wiki

Andrej Karpathy describes a wiki that a language model maintains from raw sources.

Raw sources are kept unchanged, and the model writes and updates the wiki pages.

A schema page tells the model which conventions the wiki follows.

The pattern runs three operations, which are ingest, query and lint.

Unlike retrieval-augmented generation, the wiki accumulates knowledge between questions.

Fixture page for the bookmark wiki tests.
